whatIsThis.heading: WHAT IS THIS?
whatIsThis.body: Radio Calico isn't just a radio player - it's a live demonstration. The real thing being tested here is the workflow itself: a human and Claude's GitHub agent working entirely through GitHub issues and pull requests, from planning through tests, code, and review, to prove an AI agent can deliver production-grade work end to end with a human approving every step along the way.

steps.title: Issue Trigger
steps.description: A human kicks things off by opening a GitHub issue describing what's needed.

steps.title: Plan & AC Gate
steps.description: The AI proposes a plan with clear success criteria, and a human must approve it before anything else happens.

steps.title: TDD Gate
steps.description: The AI writes tests that describe the desired outcome before any feature code exists, and a human signs off on them first.

steps.title: Implementation Gate
steps.description: Only after the tests are approved does the AI write the actual feature code to make them pass.

steps.title: Review & Merge Gate
steps.description: A human reviews the finished work against quality and security checks, then merges it in to close the loop.

steps.title: Close & Capture Gate
steps.description: Lessons learned along the way get written down and turned into reusable know-how for the next round.

firstTime.title: First Time
firstTime.body: When a human makes a call - choosing an approach, setting a rule, giving feedback - the agent writes it down and saves it as a new skill in .claude/skills/.

nextTime.title: Next Time
nextTime.body: In later loops, the agent automatically checks that stored skill and applies it, so its behavior stays consistent with what was decided before.
